bounded_question: What visibly non-sequential treatment may mark replacement of one already-ready context by another while remaining distinct from F1A and avoiding process, priority, direction, causality, or Stage semantics?

controlled_inputs.mechanism: CS2 Balanced Crossfade Exchange: synchronized field-level opacity exchange between already-ready contexts with no element-level stagger, transform, blur, scale, spring, or directional travel.
controlled_inputs.research_fixture: 280 ms and cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1) are comparison fixtures only.

local_result.summary: CS2 is the provisional shared-brand mechanism for eligible replacement of one already-ready context by another; CUT is a first-class fallback.
rejections: dense-text ghosting when overlap becomes fatiguing

judgment.design_sol_view: A1 ready peer context approved; A2/A3 approved with restraint; N1/N3 prohibited; N2 uses CUT fallback.
judgment.director_view_or_delegation: Director selected CS2 for its easy-on-the-eyes, low-micro-twitch-fatigue, gentle mysterious quality, then explicitly delegated the detailed use-envelope judgment to Design Sol.

mechanical: Q-DESIGN-16 hosted exemplar preflight: 24/24 FULL + 24/24 REDUCED plus interruption-retarget checks
accessibility: reduced motion = immediate final context with zero animation
interruption/retarget = cancel and CUT to newest authoritative context
visual: A1 strongest expression of the calm/slightly magical context-boundary character
dense text overlap becomes perceptually noisy and therefore falls back to CUT

known_integration_sensitivities: F1A and CS2 may not explain the same transition event.
Incoming semantic/interaction ownership must be authoritative independently of the fade.
Typography density and color contrast can turn overlap into ghosting/fatigue; whole-surface synthesis must retest this.
Host geometry changes or unavailable incoming content require CUT rather than forcing CS2.
explicit_non_authority: 280 ms/easing are research fixtures, not production tokens.
No universal context-transition rule, app/site/navigation implementation, Stage motion, final motion system, final identity or Phase-C convergence is authorized.

director_review_surface.what_to_review: Allowed, restrained, prohibited and CUT-fallback uses of context replacement.
